desc: three flat tones: black, a colour you pick, and white

params.name: colour
params.help: the middle tone around the wheel — 0.14 is screenprint yellow, 0.0 red, 0.35 green, 0.6 blue

params.name: pixel
params.help: chunk size — near-full resolution down to fat blocks

params.name: dither
params.help: stipple along the tone boundaries; 0 is hard-edged poster art

params.name: balance
params.help: slides both cuts — low floods the frame white, high sinks it into black
